Hints to Lojban vowels '''a''' and '''e''': these values do not exactly exist in Hungarian.

'''a''' is pronounced  like Hungarian '''á''', but is about the length of Hungarian '''a''';
'''e''' is about the length of Hungarian '''e''', but pronounced much closer (yet not as close as Hungarian '''é'''!).
